The 2026 Magic Millions Gold Coast Horses In Training Sale catalogue has been released. It features 174 lots of 2-year-olds and 3-year-olds plus supplementary lots. With breeze-ups scheduled for the end of September, the sale will be held on October 12 at their Gold Coast facility.

Arrowfield Stud and Hermitage-owned mare Autumn Glow is the 2025/26 Australian Horse Of The Year. Trainer Chris Waller won the Group 1 Trainer Award and James McDonald won the Group 1 Jockey Award. From $10,000 to $1.8 million, Champions can be bought for a whole range of prices.

Cox Plate headed Sir Delius was impressive in his trial at Randwick on Friday, overcoming a poor start to fly home for a victory. The hot sprint heat was won by Way To The Stars from Headley Grange with Joliestar having a solid hitout in midfield. St Gotthard, Beskar and Italian Spirit were all impressive.

In today's Stable Tours, Sam Freedman walks us through the spring plans for the horses he trains in partnership with his father. Progressive Point Barrow will take aim at the G1 Moir Stakes, exciting 3-year-old American Eagle aims high this spring, and the offspring of former stable star Artorius have impressed.

Riversdale Farm are spreading the love across the Hunter Valley this season, sending mares to a wide variety of stallions both proven and new. Nick Hodges spoke to TTR about where their favourite mares are headed in 2026.

Tony Rider’s acquisition of The Oaks Stud is set to create a significantly expanded New Zealand breeding operation, with Marc Devcich appointed to combine it with Milan Park, oversee its rebranding and help secure another commercial stallion for 2027.

A pair of bluebloods won stylishly at Canterbury with stakes targets now being planned for them. Hong Kong Derby winner Cap Ferrat's full brother Tenenbaum was joined in the winner's circle by Godolphin's Piedmont, whose first three dams are all Group 1 winners.

Bell River Thoroughbreds will be throwing the weight of their broodmare band behind some of the country's hottest young sires this spring.
